blocks.text: Cricket update: West Indies beat Pakistan & dedicate win to Sobers. Jayden Seales takes 5-20 in second innings as West Indies' pace attack ruthlessly blow away Pakistan to secure a 90-run victory just after tea on day four of the first Test.
